dropright.title: DropRight
dropright.description: A logistics and delivery management platform that streamlines shipment tracking, order management, and operational workflows.
responsibilities: Developed responsive user interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript.
Built reusable UI components to improve development efficiency.
Integrated REST APIs for real-time data management.
Collaborated with designers to deliver pixel-perfect interfaces.
Optimized application performance and user experience.

regTu.title: Thammasat University Registration System
regTu.description: An online registration platform for Thammasat University, allowing users to register for courses, manage schedules, and access academic services through a modern bilingual interface.
responsibilities: Developed the complete frontend UI based on Figma designs using Next.js 14 (App Router) and TypeScript.
Built responsive and reusable UI components for the entire registration system.
Implemented bilingual support (Thai / English) using an internationalization (i18n) solution.
Collaborated with designers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.
Converted Figma designs into responsive, production-ready pages.

educationFair.title: Education Fair
educationFair.description: An event platform for education fairs, allowing students to explore institutions, register for activities, and access event information.
responsibilities: Developed the registration system for schools and parents to participate in Open House events.
Built a responsive multi-step registration form UI.
Created reusable UI components with responsive design.
Collaborated with designers to deliver pixel-perfect interfaces based on Figma designs.

wonderSeas.title: Wonder Seas
